verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe self-hosting the App Server on infrastructure you control, with all agent state (messages, memory, provider connections) staying on-device and no Letta account required, plus a default local mode that stores agent state locally without login. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployment (e.g., community reports of running it) and clearer docs on production self-hosting requirements (scaling, persistence backends).
